Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 16 · NFL Week 10 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 16, 4:38 PM ET

Derrick Henry has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chargers at Ravens DraftKings Showdown: 16.3 points at $10,000 FLEX, 24.5 at captain for $15,000. Across 100,000 simulations Henry holds 69% of the winning-lineup credit. Jacoby Brissett holds the most, at 79%. The case against Henry is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 4.4 points at a $10,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 39.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 26.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Henry at captain. Zay Flowers is the next captain in line, at 21.2%. The model gives him 6.7 targets on 21.4 routes.

Baltimore is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 22 for the Ravens and 17.5 for the Chargers. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Henry and Flowers, the next projections are Jacoby Brissett (15.2, $9,200), Justin Herbert (14.9, $9,000) and Omarion Hampton (8.6, $7,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 16, 4:38 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Derrick Henry holds 26.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.5 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.8 carries and 1.3 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Henry averaged 16.3 points with a simulated floor of 4.4 and a ceiling of 33.4. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 26.0% as the captain and 43.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Zay Flowers, BAL WR ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Zay Flowers holds 21.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 15.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.7 targets on 21.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Flowers averaged 15.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 40.4. He holds 58% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.2% as the captain and 36.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Herbert, LAC QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Justin Herbert holds 14.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 14.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.1 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Herbert averaged 14.9 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 28.2. He holds 76% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.2% as the captain and 62.3% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Chargers vs Ravens

Jacoby Brissett, BAL QB ($9,200 FLEX / $13,800 CPT)

Jacoby Brissett carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.2 DraftKings points for a $9,200 FLEX salary ($13,800 at captain). The model includes 3.0 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Brissett averaged 15.3 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 28.4. He holds 79% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.9% as the captain and 65.8% in a FLEX spot.

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

Omarion Hampton carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 8.6 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 11.7 carries and 1.8 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Hampton averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 15.4. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.0% as the captain and 26.1% in a FLEX spot.

Tre' Harris, LAC WR ($6,800 FLEX / $10,200 CPT)

Tre' Harris carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 8.6 DraftKings points for a $6,800 FLEX salary ($10,200 at captain). The model gives him 4.8 targets on 23.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Harris averaged 8.5 points with a simulated floor of 1.0 and a ceiling of 20.2. He holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.8% as the captain and 25.5% in a FLEX spot.

Riley Patterson, BAL K ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Riley Patterson carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 8.1 DraftKings points for a $4,600 FLEX salary ($6,900 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Patterson averaged 8.1 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 16.5. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.2% as the captain and 28.8% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Ravens, BAL DST ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Ravens projects for 7.5 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.87 projected points per $1,000. Across 100,000 simulations Ravens averaged 7.6 points with a simulated floor of -2.0 and a ceiling of 16.6. It holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.8% as the captain and 33.7% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Chargers, LAC DST ($3,400 FLEX / $5,100 CPT)

Chargers projects for 5.6 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.64 projected points per $1,000. Across 100,000 simulations Chargers averaged 5.7 points with a simulated floor of -1.9 and a ceiling of 15.7. It holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.0% as the captain and 17.7% in a FLEX spot.

Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Derrick Henry holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 26.0%, ahead of Zay Flowers (21.2%) and Justin Herbert (14.2%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Chargers vs Ravens?

Build around Derrick Henry at captain with Jacoby Brissett, Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (293 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Derrick Henry leads the SPAGS model at 16.3 DraftKings points for $10,000 at FLEX, or 24.5 points at captain for $15,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Chargers vs Ravens Showdown?

Zay Flowers is the most expensive player at $10,400 FLEX and $15,600 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Ravens (7.5 points at $4,000), Riley Patterson (8.1 points at $4,600) and Chargers (5.6 points at $3,400).

What is the Chargers vs Ravens spread and total?

The Ravens are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 39.5, with implied team totals of 22 for the Ravens and 17.5 for the Chargers.
